lisa: Quick heads-up — running a focused sweep for ownerless admin roles ahead of the monthly access review. Linter flagged ~12 items; calling out any that touch KMS, prod clusters, or payment scopes as high-priority.

mike: Thanks. Can you paste the linter query/output so I can cross-check?

lisa: Sure — running this locally: 
```bash
gcloud asset search-all-iam-policies --scope=organizations/1234567890 --query='policy:roles/* AND -bindings.members:admin-owner@company.com' --format=json > ownerless-roles.json
jq '.[] | {name: .resource, roles: .policy.bindings[].role}' ownerless-roles.json | head -n 40
```
Output shows: `projects/payment-prod/iamPolicy` -> roles/editor (binding missing owner label), and `k8s_cluster:infra-stage` -> roles/clusterAdmin with no owner tag.

olivia: I saw `svcacct-kms-binding-ops@svc` on that list — that one has KMS grants to `projects/redwood/.../ent-scrub` and touches production keys. Mark as urgent.

kevin: Hold removal on any role referenced by current vuln triage. We have an active CVE triage (CVE-2026-1234) where a service path uses `roles/clusterAdmin` for a hotfix; removing could break mitigations. I'll annotate the linter output with `triage:hold` for anything in `triage-tracker`.

mike: Proposed plan: 1) export CSV of flagged roles and owners, 2) automail owners with simulated handback link, 3) for roles with no owner after 72h, schedule an ent-handback dry-run (no deletion) and create PR templates removing privileged bindings. Who can run the export?

lisa: @audit-bot please dump the review CSV and include last grant times.

audit-bot: Exporting audit: gs://redwood-audit/access-review/1768889998-ownerless-flag.csv, records: 12, fields: resource,role,binding, lastGrantTs, lastUsedTs. Ticket created SEC-802.

kevin: Also add a column `kms-affected` true/false by checking `gcloud kms keys list` bindings — I can run that and update CSV.

mike: I'll prepare the ent-handback playbook run id `ent-handback-v3` in dry-run mode and set notify window to 72h. Playbook will produce PRs in infra-policy repo with suggested removals.

mike: Small nit: use `--simulate` mode for entitlement playbook to generate PRs but don't merge. We should run the RBAC regression test harness after PR generation: `infra-policy/test/rbac-smoke.sh`.

kevin: CVE note: for any role that references `system:masters` or `roles/clusterAdmin`, tag `highblast` and coordinate with infra/patching team. We cannot remove those until cluster patch window is complete.

lisa: Agreed. I'll add columns `action: notify|dryrun|hold` and `reason` to the CSV. Schedule cleanup wave for 2026-04-05 02:00 UTC maintenance window for items that are `notify` or `dryrun` with no owner response.

mike: I'll kick the playbook next Monday as dry-run and post PR links here.

kevin: Reminder: for any KMS-granted roles flagged, verify keyPolicy delta and rotate keys only if exposure confirmed. Don't rotate as first step; prefer granular policy removal and evidence collection.

lisa: A few ops tasks: 1) assign owners for entries where we can identify a team, 2) add `jira:SEC-802` to CSV header, 3) attach triage hold tags per kevin. I'll update the spreadsheet and share link.

mike: FYI I'll also add a small smoke test: ensure `kubectl auth can-i escalate` passes for none of the simulated PRs.

lisa: Thanks. Closing intermediate loop — will re-open if any item is blocking. SEC-802 will carry more notes.

kevin: Thanks all.

sre-bot: Note: entitlement-playbooks are rate-limited to 1 wave/hr. Use caution if we parallelize.

lisa: Perfect. Re-open thread if owners respond or triage changes.
